prologue.noscript: The prologue is interactive and needs JavaScript. You can still start with the XOR lesson.
prologue.wire.label: The wire between Alice and Bob
prologue.scene.note.title: Alice writes a note
prologue.scene.note.lead: Alice wants to send Bob a short note. Change it if you like: it never leaves your browser.
prologue.scene.note.empty: Type at least one character to continue.
prologue.scene.note.explain: Computers send text as bytes (UTF-8). Nothing hides them: whoever taps the wire turns them straight back into text.
prologue.scene.encrypt.title: A shared secret key
prologue.scene.encrypt.lead: Earlier, Alice and Bob met in person and agreed on a random key: one random byte for every byte of the note. Now Alice XORs each byte of the note with the matching key byte.
prologue.scene.encrypt.newKeyDone: New random key. Eve sees different noise.
prologue.scene.encrypt.explain: Without the key, the noise fits every note of this length equally well. Eve learns the length, nothing more.
prologue.scene.decrypt.title: Bob unlocks the note
prologue.scene.decrypt.lead: Bob has the same key. XORing with it a second time cancels it out: (note ⊕ key) ⊕ key = note.
prologue.scene.decrypt.explain: Same key, same operation, in both directions. That is the heart of every symmetric cipher, AES included.
prologue.scene.choose.title: How do you want to explore?
prologue.scene.choose.lead: Pick a lens. It sets how deep every lesson goes, and you can switch it anytime in the header.
prologue.lens.story.description: The big ideas and the people behind them, with very little math.
prologue.lens.engineer.description: How it works in code: bytes, steps and official test vectors.
prologue.lens.cryptographer.description: The full picture: field arithmetic, design reasons and attacks.
prologue.eve.title: What Eve sees
prologue.done.title: You’re all set
prologue.done.lens: You’re exploring with the {{lens}} lens. Switch anytime with the Lens menu in the header.
prologue.welcomeBack.title: Welcome back
prologue.welcomeBack.body: You finished the prologue on {{date}}. Your lens: {{lens}}.
